Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator first erred by instructing FileSurfer to “listen to” and extract page numbers from the audio despite the known constraint that the audio could not be transcribed (“Error. Could not transcribe this audio”) and FileSurfer’s inability to actually listen. It then repeatedly reissued the same ineffective instruction and pursued web services requiring account sign-in instead of leveraging viable in-environment options (e.g., using ComputerTerminal to run a local ASR like Whisper). This poor delegation and failure to adapt led to no transcript and culminated in an unsupported, incorrect final answer.
